title: Restriction identifies the proper coefficient comparison with the pro-etale projection map
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$; let $\bar X$ and $Y$ be separated schemes of finite type over $k$ and $p:\bar X\to Y$ a proper $k$-morphism [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of finite commutative rings killed by powers of $\ell$. On the small pro-étale sites use the ordinary uncompleted constant-ring module derived categories $D(T_{\mathrm{proét}},R)$ for $R=A,B$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], the derived adjunctions $p_R^*\dashv Rp_{*,R}$ with counits $\varepsilon^R$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], the constant-ring identifications $p^{-1}R_Y\simeq R_{\bar X}$ [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map], and scalar extension $T_T=(-)\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{A_T}B_T$ with its $B_T$-action [det-sp-scalar-extension-functor]. Let $r_T:D(T_{\mathrm{proét}},B)\to D(T_{\mathrm{proét}},A)$ be restriction of scalars, so that $r_TT_TK=K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{A_T}B_T$ with $B_T$ regarded as an $A_T$-module, and let $d:r_YRp_{*,B}\xrightarrow{\sim}Rp_{*,A}r_{\bar X}$ be the canonical comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction]. For $N\in D(\bar X_{\mathrm{proét}},A)$ let
$$\gamma_N:T_YRp_{*,A}N\longrightarrow Rp_{*,B}T_{\bar X}N$$
be the unique $B$-linear map whose adjoint transpose under $p_B^*\dashv Rp_{*,B}$, after the canonical identification $p_B^*T_Y\simeq T_{\bar X}p_A^*$ of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback], is $T_{\bar X}(\varepsilon^A_N)$. Then the $A$-linear map
$$d_{T_{\bar X}N}\circ r_Y(\gamma_N):Rp_{*,A}N\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{A_Y}B_Y\longrightarrow Rp_{*,A}\bigl(N\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{A_{\bar X}}B_{\bar X}\bigr)$$
is the pro-étale projection morphism for the coefficient object $B_Y$: its adjoint transpose under $p_A^*\dashv Rp_{*,A}$, composed with the tensor-pullback identification $p_A^*(Rp_{*,A}N\otimes^{\mathbf L}B_Y)\simeq p_A^*Rp_{*,A}N\otimes^{\mathbf L}B_{\bar X}$ of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback], is $\varepsilon^A_N\otimes^{\mathbf L}1_{B_{\bar X}}$. This identification is natural in $N$. No boundedness of $N$ and no flatness or finite Tor dimension of $B$ over $A$ is assumed.

source.place: Step 1, normalization of the proper coefficient map and its etale comparison

proof.text: Put $L_R=p_R^*$ and $R_R=Rp_{*,R}$. The identifications $c_A,c_B$ preserve constants [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map], so both maps $p^{-1}A_Y\to B_{\bar X}$ send a constant $a$ to its image in $B$. Thus the coefficient square commutes. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction] to obtain $b:r_{\bar X}L_B\simeq L_Ar_Y$ and the specified $d:r_YR_B\simeq R_Ar_{\bar X}$, including its precise adjunct identity.

source.place: Step 1, normalization of the proper coefficient map and its etale comparison

proof.text: Write $\theta_K:L_BT_YK\simeq T_{\bar X}L_AK$ for the comparison defining $\gamma$. It is the comparison $\lambda_p$ of [def-sp-constant-scalar-pullback-comparison] for the constant rings and the constant-ring maps induced by $A\to B$: that node defines $\lambda_p$ as the ringed reduction/pullback isomorphism, i.e. the tensor-pullback comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback] applied with the coefficient module and the constant-section identifications $c_A,c_B$, which is the identification named in the statement. Apply [lem-sp-proetale-scalar-tensor-normalization] with $f=p$ and this $\theta$. It gives $r_{\bar X}(\theta_K)\circ b^{-1}_{T_YK}=\tau_K$, including the canonical pure-tensor formula and scalar-counit localization square on every flat-term K-flat representative. Its hypotheses require neither properness nor boundedness.

source.place: Step 1, normalization of the proper coefficient map and its etale comparison

proof.text: Set $t=T_{\bar X}(\varepsilon^A_N)\circ\theta_{R_AN}$; its $B$-adjunct is $\gamma_N$ by definition. The adjunct clause of [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction] identifies the $A$-transpose of $d_{T_{\bar X}N}\circ r_Y(\gamma_N)$ with $r_{\bar X}(t)\circ b^{-1}_{T_YR_AN}$. By Step 2 and the map formula $T(v)=v\otimes^{\mathbf L}1_B$ [det-sp-scalar-extension-functor], this is $(\varepsilon^A_N\otimes^{\mathbf L}1_B)\circ\tau_{R_AN}$. Injectivity of the adjunction bijection gives the asserted projection morphism.

source.place: Step 1, normalization of the proper coefficient map and its etale comparison

proof.text: For $v:N\to N'$, counit naturality gives $v\varepsilon^A_N=\varepsilon^A_{N'}L_AR_A(v)$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Tensor with $1_B$ and use naturality of $\tau$ [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. With $h_N=(\varepsilon^A_N\otimes^{\mathbf L}1_B)\tau_{R_AN}$ this says $(v\otimes^{\mathbf L}1_B)h_N=h_{N'}L_A(R_A(v)\otimes^{\mathbf L}1_B)$. Naturality of the Hom bijection transposes this into naturality of the projection maps. Step 3 identifies those maps with the restricted $\gamma_N$, completing the proof on the ordinary unbounded categories.
